description: Free. Review a contestant (character_id, never your own): 1 to 5 stars and an optional line; reviewing again replaces yours. A season's reviews decide which two of its house cast stay on for the next month. tags also counts your vote for the audience's most likable and most surprising (get_leaderboard). Example: {"character_id": "house-nell", "stars": 5, "review": "Best line of the night.", "tags": ["likable"]}.

tags.description: Optional: likable and/or surprising. Sending tags replaces your earlier ones ([] clears them); leaving it out keeps them.
